1: """Regular expressions for recognising version strings."""
2: 
3: import re
4: 
5: VERSION_PATTERN = re.compile(
6:     r"(?<![\w.-])v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)"
7: )
8: VERSION_EXACT = re.compile(r"^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$")
9: 
10: 
11: def extract_versions(text):
12:     """Return version strings found in text, without a leading v."""
13:     if not isinstance(text, str):
14:         raise TypeError("text must be a string")
15:     return VERSION_PATTERN.findall(text)
16: 
17: 
18: def find_version_positions(text):
19:     """Return start, end and text of each version found in text."""
20:     if not isinstance(text, str):
21:         raise TypeError("text must be a string")
22:     return [
23:         (match.start(1), match.end(1), match.group(1))
24:         for match in VERSION_PATTERN.finditer(text)
25:     ]
26: 
27: 
28: def is_version(text):
29:     """Return True when text is exactly one version string."""
30:     if not isinstance(text, str):
31:         return False
32:     return VERSION_EXACT.fullmatch(text) is not None
33: 
34: 
35: def has_prerelease(version):
36:     """Return True when a version carries a prerelease suffix."""
37:     if not isinstance(version, str):
38:         raise TypeError("version must be a string")
39:     return "-" in version
40: 
41: 
42: def replace_versions(text, replacement):
43:     """Return text with every recognised version replaced."""
44:     if not isinstance(text, str):
45:         raise TypeError("text must be a string")
46:     if not isinstance(replacement, str):
47:         raise TypeError("replacement must be a string")
48:     return VERSION_PATTERN.sub(replacement, text)

11:         majors.append(int(core.split(".", 1)[0]))

17:     groups = {}

19:         core = version.split("-", 1)[0]
20:         major = int(core.split(".", 1)[0])
21:         groups.setdefault(major, []).append(version)
22:     return groups
